## Landed in 2 changes

| Gerrit | Merge SHA | Change |
|---|---|---|
| 3420 | dd72b461814c504c6fad144d5b2b178fe17e30dd | The crash guard writes the banner and stacks through `sys.stderr`. |
| 3422 | de94cc70b3be8d828e4ac612c553ed4d1756a60f | The test's emulation of Windows stderr applies only off Windows. |

Both had LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 and were landed with gerrit_safe_submit.py. `make verify` exited 0 on each:
- 3420: 21360 passed; integration tier 226 passed.
- 3422: 21360 passed; integration tier 226 passed.

## Windows sweeps after merge

| Run | At | Job | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 44232977541 | dd72b461814 | 134562252974 | 3 failed, 19627 passed |
| 44253676986 | de94cc70b3b | 134630144542 | 0 failed, 19661 passed |

In run 44232977541:
- The original xdist timeout test passed on Windows.
- The real-worker banner reached the controller. It named bd66 as a genuine 600 s timeout inside `_fill_loose`'s `git hash-object --stdin-paths`. That is filed as powderblue-effectual-racerunner.
- The new emulation test failed because its sitecustomize stacked with execnet's own redirection. 3422 fixed that.
- `test_unique_cache_writes` failed, unrelated to this bug. That is filed as sporting-feudalist-bluet.

Run 44253676986 passed in full, with all crash-guard tests passing on Windows.
